verdict.rationale: Lovable documents exporting the full app codebase: you can download it directly or sync it to a GitHub/GitLab repo you own, then deploy outside Lovable. The backend runs on Supabase's open-source foundation and offers direct SQL access. However, nothing in the evidence documents exporting the database contents, users, or storage in open formats, so 'all of my data' is only half covered. Missing for 10: a documented database/user/storage data export, a documented backend migration path off Lovable Cloud, and independent hands-on corroboration of a full exit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: If you only need a copy of your code, you can download your code directly from Lovable: use the Download codebase section in Project settings → Git
you can export and sync your project to GitHub: back up your code, review changes in pull requests, work locally in your IDE, test features on branches, and deploy outside Lovable
Git sync connects a Lovable project to a repository you own on GitHub or GitLab, and keeps the two in sync automatically
The built-in backend utilizes Supabase's open-source foundation
